name: Arcadia Nature Camp
description_short: A Mass Audubon nature day camp for ages 5–15 at Arcadia Wildlife Sanctuary in Easthampton, Monday to Friday, 9 am to 3 pm. Campers hike, play games, make crafts and explore forests, meadows, streams and vernal pools, with specialty weeks for nature photography and environmental leadership.
